narrative: Today's tech brief highlights significant advancements in AI, with Meta releasing its new frontier model, Muse Wonder, and ongoing discussions about AI's impact on software development and the need for regulation. Meanwhile, cybersecurity remains a critical concern following a major cyberattack impacting French supermarkets, and NASA continues pushing boundaries with health research launches to the ISS. New consumer tech like the Fitbit Edge also makes headlines, alongside advancements in cloud infrastructure for log management.

highlights.title: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder
highlights.whyItMatters: Meta's new, larger Wonder models are designed for more complex tasks, including coding, indicating a significant leap in AI capabilities.

highlights.title: French supermarkets suffer refrigerator shutdown after unprecedented cyberattack
highlights.whyItMatters: This cyberattack demonstrates the critical vulnerability of physical infrastructure to digital threats, impacting essential services.

highlights.title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to teach Copilot about your codebase
highlights.whyItMatters: New tools are emerging to integrate AI more deeply into developer workflows, promising increased productivity and a new way to interact with code.

highlights.title: NASA’s SpaceX CRS-35 Mission to Launch Health Research
highlights.whyItMatters: Space missions continue to advance critical research in human and plant health, benefiting both Earth-bound life and future space exploration.

highlights.title: AI coding agents generate more code, but not more software
highlights.whyItMatters: This highlights the ongoing challenge and debate around the actual impact and effectiveness of AI in producing functional and robust software.

highlights.title: Filter, reshape, and redact logs before export with Transformers
highlights.whyItMatters: Cloudflare's new feature enhances data management and security by allowing advanced processing of log streams at the edge.

highlights.title: Fitbit Edge is Google’s middle ground between Fitbit Air and Pixel Watch
highlights.whyItMatters: Google introduces a new wearable, bridging the gap between basic fitness trackers and full smartwatches, catering to a broader market.

highlights.title: Microsoft president says UK is best placed to drive AI regulation
highlights.whyItMatters: The call for urgent AI regulation from a major tech leader underscores the growing recognition of the need for oversight in AI development and deployment.
